title: Vickers Wellington HF570
memorial_details:
Unfinished, rectangular block of York Stone with square, polished, black granite plaque on the front face.

The memorial is erected at RAF Desborough, indicating a strong community connection.
inscription: IN MEMORY OF/ Plt Off Reginald Elwyn Byrne/ Sgt Edward Brisbourne/ Sgt William John Barnett/ WHO DIED NEAR THIS SPOT IN THE CRASH OF/ WELLINGTON BOMBER HF570/ ON THE 5TH OF SEPTEMBER 1944/ AND OF THEIR UNSELFISH, GALLANT SACRIFICE/ IN THE CAUSE OF FREEDOM./ THESE MEN WERE MEMBERS OF BOMBER COMMAND, 84 OPERATIONAL TRAINING UNIT/ BASED AT RAF DESBOROUGH./ WE ALSO RECOGNISE THE SACRIFICE OF/ OTHER AIRMEN WHO LOST THEIR LIVES/ DURING TRAINING AT RAF DESBOROUGH
community_connection: The memorial is maintained by Desborough Civic Society.
